command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== step: baseline secure log sudo line count =="
sudo -n grep -c 'sudo:' /var/log/secure || true

echo "== step: write sudoers.d drop-in =="
cat <<'EOF' | sudo -n tee /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging >/dev/null
Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo-commands.log"
Defaults log_input, log_output
Defaults iolog_dir="/var/log/sudo-io"
Defaults !syslog
EOF
sudo -n chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging

echo "== step: validate syntax =="
sudo -n visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging

echo "== step: ensure log file exists with safe perms =="
sudo -n touch /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo -n chmod 600 /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo -n chown root:root /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "== step: run a test sudo command to trigger logging =="
sudo -n whoami

echo "== verify: dedicated log content =="
sudo -n cat /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "== verify: general system log NOT updated with this new sudo entry =="
sudo -n grep -c 'sudo:' /var/log/secure || true
sudo -n journalctl -q --since "-5 minutes" 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'sudo:.*whoami' || echo "no sudo whoami entry in journal (expected)"
